# Bid the wall, the pattern, and the extras.

> Price a kitchen tile backsplash from wall square feet, subway versus herringbone versus mosaic versus large-format, tile-only versus new-prep versus demo-and-replace, owner-supplied versus you-supply, weekday versus occupied versus after-hours, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $35 / SF special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
